title: Retire the message-feedback README claim that no client aggregate or UI exists
task:
Problem: packages/feedback/message-feedback/README.md:78 lists "Client aggregate and UI are absent — the Host Remote contract ships, but the Client Remote aggregate contribution and any UI consumer are separately owned and deferred", packages/feedback/message-feedback/README.md:48 says "The Client Remote aggregate does not mount the generated client contribution yet; Host callers can use the service/Remote contract without that client assembly.", and the family README repeats it at packages/feedback/README.md:14 ("the client Remote aggregate mount and UI consumer are separately owned and deferred"). All three are false on the current tree: packages/api/remotes/src/client/index.ts mounts the `messageFeedback` client contribution in the Client Remote aggregate (`grep -n messageFeedback packages/api/remotes/src/client/index.ts`), and packages/client/ui-message-feedback is the shipped UI consumer — its README.md:5-9 describes the Like/Dislike pair contributed as the `feedback` entry of the `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` strip, mutating through `ctx.remote.messageFeedback` with the per-item `version` compare-and-set this package documents. The Chinese counterparts carry the same statements at packages/feedback/message-feedback/README.zh.md:48, README.zh.md:78, and packages/feedback/README.zh.md:14.

Required: delete the bullet at message-feedback/README.md:78; replace the sentence at message-feedback/README.md:48 and the clause at packages/feedback/README.md:14 with one clause each that names the client aggregate (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes`) and links the UI consumer (`../../client/ui-message-feedback/README.md` from the package README, `../client/ui-message-feedback/README.md` from the family README) as the shipped consumers; mirror the edits in both README.zh.md files; re-record with `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write packages/feedback/message-feedback/README.md packages/feedback/README.md`; run `pnpm run doc-sync` and regenerate only what it reports stale.

Constraints: documentation only, no source change; keep the other Known Limitations bullets (they remain true); do not edit the client package, the remotes aggregate, or command-feedback; mechanical, local edit under the Agent Note exemption.

acceptance.run: ! grep -q 'Client aggregate and UI are absent' packages/feedback/message-feedback/README.md
! grep -q 'does not mount the generated client contribution yet' packages/feedback/message-feedback/README.md
